source: fresh GitHub repo + fresh Cloudflare resources, from topology + one-paragraph idea

stages.name: repo-provision
stages.description: Create fresh empty GitHub repository from topology spec (foundation/topology.py) and one-paragraph idea.

failures.error: initial push rejected: branch protection required linear history
failures.fix: seeded bootstrap commit on main before enabling protection rules

stages.name: roles-hired
stages.description: Hire roles per topology: driver (tick scheduler), executor (change implementer), audit (merge gate).

failures.error: executor role initially spawned without GitHub token scope to create branches
failures.fix: re-issued fine-grained PAT with contents:write on the fresh repo

stages.name: queue-seeded
stages.description: Seed work queue with initial items derived from the idea paragraph.

failures.error: Cloudflare Queue not yet created in fresh account
failures.fix: created queue via wrangler queues create and bound producer/consumer in wrangler.toml

stages.name: tick-deployed
stages.description: Deploy tick worker on fresh Cloudflare resources (KV namespace, Queue, Durable Object).

failures.error: DO binding failed: class not exported from worker entry
failures.fix: exported DO class and added migrations tag v1 with new_sqlite_classes

stages.name: executor-deployed
stages.description: Deploy executor worker consuming queue, opening branches and PRs.

failures.error: first queue delivery failed auth against GitHub API (401)
failures.fix: stored token as Cloudflare secret, not plaintext var

stages.name: unattended-merge
stages.description: Executor implemented first queued item autonomously, opened PR, audit gate approved, merged with no human intervention.

failures.error: first PR attempt blocked: required status check not configured on fresh repo
failures.fix: added CI check name to branch protection required contexts before retry

stages.name: transparency-page
stages.description: /live-style transparency page serving live state: roles, queue depth, merged PR, tick log.

port_test_note: Stage/fix pairs form the porting checklist for PORT-EXEC-1 (other platforms).
